epistemic_status.scope: gate specification only; no RMR execution or physical-device attestation

research_delta.title: ClaimReceipt: Verifying Evidence Sufficiency and Coverage in Agent Evaluations
research_delta.direct_observation: The paper separates recomputability from coverage and requires a prospectively committed expected universe.

research_delta.title: The Acknowledgment Point Is the System: Durable Policy-Decision Receipts for AI Audit Evidence
research_delta.direct_observation: The paper requires durable append/synchronization before acknowledging a durable receipt and fail-stop on append failure.

research_delta.title: Git Hash Chain Malleability
research_delta.direct_observation: The paper demonstrates multiple valid signed serializations of one logical commit, each with a different Git hash; it does not demonstrate a hash collision or content forgery.

required_gates.requirement: Commit the expected record set before outcomes exist, including identifiers, retry policy, terminal-state policy, schema version, and canonical serialization profile.
required_gates.pass: Every expected identifier resolves to exactly one typed terminal receipt or one typed TOKEN_VAZIO with reason; no undeclared identifier appears.
required_gates.fail: Missing, duplicate, undeclared, or post-hoc expected-universe entry.

required_gates.requirement: A receipt marked durable may be acknowledged only after append and the declared synchronization boundary succeed.
required_gates.pass: Crash/restart recovery preserves an exact contiguous prefix; append/sync failure yields fail-stop and no success receipt.
required_gates.fail: Acknowledged durable receipt is absent after recovery, or sequence gaps are silently accepted.

required_gates.requirement: Publish or independently retain signed/checkpointed heads and compare them across at least two trust domains.
required_gates.pass: Observers converge on one successor relation for the same predecessor, or any fork is explicitly detected and preserved.
required_gates.fail: Conflicting valid heads are accepted without a fork witness.

required_gates.requirement: Bind Git commit ID, tree ID, canonical manifest digest, artifact digest, BLAKE3/RMR digest, and verifier version as distinct fields.
required_gates.pass: Independent readback recomputes all content digests and detects any alias or mismatch without treating Git Verified status as sufficient.
required_gates.fail: Trust is derived from commit ID or forge badge alone.

required_gates.requirement: A second verifier, outside the producer execution, reconstructs the manifest and verifies the receipt chain and selected artifact.
required_gates.pass: Independent verifier reproduces the same digests and typed verdict from retained inputs.
required_gates.fail: Only the producer's self-report is available.

falsifiers: Delete one terminal receipt while preserving all remaining hashes: GATE-C1 must not PASS.
Acknowledge before fsync and simulate process termination: GATE-C2 must not PASS if the receipt disappears.
Serve two valid successor heads to isolated observers: GATE-C3 must detect the fork after head exchange.
Substitute a semantically equivalent signed Git serialization with a different commit ID: GATE-C4 must compare canonical content fields and preserve the alias.
Run verification only inside the producer trust domain: GATE-C5 remains TOKEN_VAZIO.
invariants: claim_allowed=false until all claim-relative gates pass

rollback.action: Do not delete prior records; add a successor record that identifies this record_id and the failed gate.
